messages:
Mia (SEO): Quick thread — bottom-up slug audit + redirect sprint for the webinar + benchmark pieces. Need clear owners and a tiny QA checklist before publish.
Nora - Content: I'll export final slugs (kebab-case, no dates) and annotate CTAs. Will drop the doc in #marketing-drafts in 30m.
Eli (Growth): UTM pattern proposal: utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=content, utm_campaign=launch_mar2026; add page_src hidden field on forms for routing.
Kevin (Dev): We'll host redirects in marketing/seo/redirects.csv (easier for non-dev edits). Middleware will: set Link rel=canonical, strip ad params (fbclid,gclid,_gl,amp), and serve 301s from that CSV.
Mia (SEO): Canonical policy: canonicalize to short kebab slug, no trailing slash on posts. For paginated lists keep rel=prev/next. Add HTML rel=canonical plus Link header.
Nora - Content: I'll add recommended anchor text and limit identical anchors to one per page. Also include 2 FAQ Qs for the landing.
Kevin (Dev): ETA: redirect CSV + middleware + smoke test verifying a sample legacy -> canonical 301 by Wed AM.
qa-bot: Reminder scheduled: run shallow crawl after PR merge.
Mia (SEO): QA checklist (1 line each): canonical header present, 301s for legacy slugs, UTMs + page_src on CTAs, FAQ and Event schema on landing. Tag me for any blockers.
